title: Propose Tickets turns a discussion into ticket proposals, only when you ask, and each side links to the other

steps.caption: A free discussion: talk it through, and nothing becomes a ticket

steps.type: I need to improve the tickets' version control but I'm not sure how

steps.caption: Agreed on something? Propose Tickets, beside Rename and Delete, asks the agent for tickets: this turn only
It proposes them through the inbox, and says in the chat what it proposed
The discussion records what it became, under its title
Its row in the Discussions section says so too
The ticket says where it came from: From DISC-1, which opens the discussion again
